description: Search verified indie projects in UluP Nexus. All filters are optional and can be combined. Returns name, one-line description, URL, a Nexus page, pricing, categories, languages and the date the listing was last verified. Generic words like "indie" or "app" are ignored; with no keywords it lists the newest projects. If nothing matches, the closest verified projects come back with exact_match false and a note.

category.description: Category slug, e.g. 'productivity' or 'project-management'. A parent category also matches its sub-categories. Use list_categories to see the options.

language.description: Two-letter language code the project is available in, e.g. 'en' or 'it'.

pricing_model.description: Only return projects with this pricing model.

query.description: Free-text keywords, e.g. 'pomodoro timer' or 'visual project mapping'.

name: search_projects
title: Search indie projects
